meta.title: Lawhive service model comparison
meta.jurisdiction_scope: UK public pages; entity/regulatory details mainly England and Wales
meta.browser_constraint: Main research executor had no cloud interactive browser; delegated visual worker captured public home/intake states without submission

classification.summary: Hybrid technology/referral platform plus regulated legal-service delivery
not_single_category: not one undifferentiated law firm entity

layers.client_action: submit matter information and authorize referral

layers.provider: the specific Lawyer directly engaged by the client

entities.name: Lawhive Legal Ltd
entities.role: affiliated SRA-regulated law firm within the provider network

states.observed: public onboarding route plus delegated worker capture of first step: Tell us about your case, three-part progress, free-text field, dates/deadlines/ideal-outcome prompts and Continue
states.interaction_boundary: worker did not enter text or click Continue; anonymous journey is not an account or submitted consultation

states.effect: authorizes Lawhive to refer and transmit case details
states.not_effect: does not itself make Lawhive Ltd the legal adviser

states.observed: service pages advertise quote or callback; many advertise no-obligation fixed fee

states.relationship: client directly engages specific Lawyer and accepts Lawyer terms/client-care letter

states.rule: payment on account before Lawyer starts; card or bank transfer through Service unless otherwise authorized

states.cooling_off: consumer may have 14 days; early work creates payment liability and completed work can end cancellation right

states.file_retention_claim: usually seven years, subject to law/SRA rules and matter terms

pricing.model: matter-scoped quote with prepayment; fixed-fee language common but not universal across public pages
observed: multiple service pages advertise no-obligation fixed-fee quotes
homepage/about language permits fixed fee or hourly billing
small-business page shows examples as low as GBP 149 and GBP 199
lawyer must be paid on account before starting
court, expert, counsel, hearing, travel and other disbursements may be additional

responsibility.lawhive_ltd: technology/referral service; terms exclude responsibility/duty of care for Lawyer legal services subject to non-excludable law
responsibility.lawyer: sole provider of legal services; professional duties and liability
responsibility.lawhive_guarantee: may cover paid work Lawhive determines below acceptable standard; does not guarantee desired outcome
responsibility.complaints: start with Lawyer/firm; Lawhive may help; Lawhive Legal Ltd has separate complaints policy; Legal Ombudsman may be available

observed: Lawyer-facing AI is marketed for questions, drafting, communication and next-step prediction
Labs page demonstrates briefing and demand-letter drafts
historical 2023 official research documented reasoning/empathy limits and described co-pilot positioning
terms assign legal-service responsibility to Lawyer
ai_artifact_transition.inferred: AI output is best treated as candidate work product that a Lawyer must review and adopt before client reliance or external use; public pages do not prove a mandatory product gate.

observed: Lawhive Ltd is not a law firm and does not provide legal advice.
The specific Lawyer is directly engaged and provides legal services.
Lawhive Legal Ltd is an affiliated SRA-regulated firm, not necessarily the provider on every matter.
Clients prepay before work and can instruct in writing through the Service.
The Service includes communications, documents/storage and payments.
inferred: The business model combines a two-sided platform, legal-operations layer, AI production system and regulated delivery capacity.
Marketplace and law-firm labels each describe only part of the model.
AI drafts should remain internal candidates until the responsible Lawyer adopts them.
proposed: Model platform, quote, engagement, regulated provider, payment, AI draft and external artifact as separate objects.
Require conflict/KYC/engagement/payment gates before work starts.
Record Lawyer adoption, client instruction and external-send approval as separate events.
